assertions.subject: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
assertions.quote: Rapid focal tooth loosening is most often due to infection, but rarer causes include Langerhans cell histiocytosis

assertions.quote: Rapid focal tooth loosening is most often due to infection, but rarer causes include Ewing’s sarcoma

assertions.quote: Rapid focal tooth loosening is most often due to infection, but rarer causes include osteosarcoma

assertions.quote: Rapid focal tooth loosening is most often due to infection, but rarer causes include Burkitt’s lymphoma

assertions.subject: hypophosphatasia
assertions.quote: Early loss of primary teeth is a feature of hypophosphatasia

assertions.subject: periodontal disease

assertions.subject: idiopathic familial gingival fibromatosis
assertions.quote: Idiopathic familial gingival fibromatosis and several syndrome-related disorders cause similar conditions

assertions.subject: HIV infection
assertions.quote: Linear gingival erythema is variably seen in patients with advanced HIV infection

assertions.subject: acute myelomonocytic leukemia
assertions.quote: Diffuse or focal gingival swelling may be a feature of early or late acute myelomonocytic leukemia

assertions.subject: lymphoproliferative disorders
assertions.quote: Diffuse or focal gingival swelling may be a feature of early or late acute myelomonocytic leukemia as well as of other lymphoproliferative disorders

assertions.subject: granulomatosis with polyangiitis
assertions.quote: A rare but pathognomonic sign of granulomatosis with polyangiitis is a red-purplish, granular gingivitis
